rooms.name: Front Gates
rooms.description: The imposing wrought iron gates of the Redmist Estate. Security is tight here.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go north to enter the courtyard.

rooms.name: Main Courtyard
rooms.description: A wide gravel driveway lined with manicured hedges and stone statues. The mansion looms ahead.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to the front gates, north to the entrance hall, or west to the gardens.

rooms.name: Formal Gardens
rooms.description: Neat flower beds, topiary, and a marble fountain. The scent of roses hangs in the air.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go east to return to the courtyard.

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: A grand and luxurious foyer, decorated with expensive portraits of the Redmist ancestry.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to the courtyard, west to the kitchen, east to the financial office, or north to the library.

rooms.name: Library & Study
rooms.description: Floor-to-ceiling mahogany shelves hold leather-bound medical journals and family histories. Bernard's desk sits by the window, still covered in his papers.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to the entrance hall or north to the master quarters.

rooms.name: Master Quarters
rooms.description: Your luxurious bedroom. A massive bed sits in the center overlooking the estate gardens through tall windows.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to return to the library.

rooms.name: Mansion Kitchen
rooms.description: An incredibly clean and extravagantly stocked stainless steel kitchen. Copper pots hang from wrought-iron racks.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go east to the entrance hall, north to the dining room, or west to the staff quarters.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.description: A long mahogany dining table beneath a crystal chandelier. The room seats twenty but feels empty now.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to return to the kitchen.

rooms.name: Staff Quarters
rooms.description: A modest corridor with small bedrooms for the live-in staff. Neat and clean, but a world away from the mansion's luxury.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go east to return to the kitchen.

rooms.name: Financial Office
rooms.description: A quiet office with plush leather seating and a heavy mahogany desk stacked with financial records.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go west to the entrance hall or north to the guest wing.

rooms.name: Guest Wing
rooms.description: A separate suite of rooms for visitors. Gabriella has made herself at home here since Bernard's passing.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to return to the financial office.
